ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $B$ is on line segment $AC$, and $AB=27\text{cm}$, $BC=\frac{1}{3}AB$. If point $O$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$, find the length of line segment $OB$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point O is the midpoint of AC, \\
$\therefore$ OC=$\frac{1}{2}$AC=$\frac{1}{2} \times 36=18$, \\
$\therefore$ OB=OC−BC=18−9=\boxed{9}.
